title: How Large are Monetary Policy Effects? dentifying the Shocks in a VAR also Identifies the Constants
abstract: arXiv:2611.34722v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Restrictions on the contemporaneous effects matrix used to identify fundamental shocks in a structural VAR, also determine the mapping from the structural constant terms to the reduced form constant terms. In some models one will have priors about these structural constant terms and these should therefore be included in a Bayesian estimation procedure. We illustrate the potential significance of this using the analysis of monetary policy by Baumeister and Hamilton (2018) as a motivating example. We show that imposing priors over the structural constant terms can lead to a more intuitive estimated monetary policy rule and a much larger estimated role for monetary policy in describing the evolution of the data. The analysis also allows for a clear visual presentation of the structural model, highlighting its multiple contending elements. translated_title: 货币政策效应有多大？识别VAR模型中的冲击同时也识别了常数项
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.34722v1 公告类型：新论文。摘要：在结构向量自回归（SVAR）模型中，用于识别基本面冲击的同期效应矩阵上的约束条件，同时决定了结构常数项到简化式常数项的映射关系。在某些模型中，研究者会对这些结构常数项持有先验信念，因此在贝叶斯估计过程中应当将这些先验纳入其中。我们以Baumeister和Hamilton（2018）的货币政策分析作为启发性示例，阐述了这一点的潜在重要性。我们表明，对结构常数项施加先验能够得到一个更为直观的估计货币政策规则，并使得货币政策在描述数据演变中所起作用的估计值大幅增加。该分析还支持对结构模型进行清晰的视觉呈现，突出其多个相互竞争的要素。例如，所观测到的通胀序列被估计为正向需求冲击和大宗商品……（原文摘要在此处不完整）
tldr: 本文的创新在于指出结构VAR中用于识别冲击的同期效应矩阵约束同时决定了结构常数项的映射，并证明在贝叶斯估计中对结构常数项施加先验（以Baumeister-Hamilton货币政策模型为例）可得到更直观的货币政策规则，同时显著提高货币政策对数据演变解释作用的估计值。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that the restrictions identifying shocks in a structural VAR also identify the structural constants, and that imposing priors on these constants—illustrated via Baumeister and Hamilton's monetary policy model—yields a more intuitive monetary policy rule and a much larger estimated role for monetary policy.
